title: Skill resource costs and Blood Mana
summary: D2R 3.3.93847 native affordability and ordinary/periodic payment explicitly select state 114. The life-payment helper also owns and can remove the original Blood Mana statlist, so extending caller predicates alone does not make a custom state independent. Charged skills and a separate start-mana gate need distinct handling.
limitations: Static proof for the governed 92777/93847 common corpus; no runtime or multiplayer qualification.
All skills and the complete client/server use-state flow are not covered; a separate start-mana gate remains relevant.
No plugin hook ownership audit or complete callable ABI; Steam 93787 is not independently qualified.
